performance.verdict: Meta is dark 5 days; pipeline shows zero opps — money cannot work right now.

findings.text: Meta has been $0 spend for 5 consecutive days (Sep 9–13); zero_spend_day and channel_dark flags confirm a full campaign stop.
CPL was $46.95 over 28 days — above the July range of $19–45/wk high; with Meta dark, no efficiency recovery is possible while spend is $0.
3 overdue SOW blockers as of Aug 31: Extension with Marwan unsigned, SMS automation not live, Zoho Voice access not granted — all gate next quarter.
GHL shows 24 contacts and 0 opportunities from 30 Meta leads (28d); 6-lead gap plus zero opps signals a broken intake handoff, not an ads problem.
Search clicks fell 34.27% week-over-week and GBP actions dropped 11.9%; organic is softening in parallel with paid going dark — no single-channel offset.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and reactivate 'Leads - August Re-Launch' campaign; confirm budget, policy, or payment caused the Sep 9 stop.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 5 consecutive days (Sep 9–13), confirmed by the zero_spend_day and channel_dark flags. Hamza/Hamdan must pull the account rejection or budget-exhaustion reason from Meta Ads Manager today and restore 'Leads - August Re-Launch' at the last active daily budget (~$65–75/day). Success check: spend resumes within 24 hours and at least 1 lead registers in GHL by Sep 16. If a policy violation caused the pause, escalate to Sohib before relaunching copy.

suggestions.text: Repair GHL intake: 30 Meta leads produced 0 opportunities; fix form-to-pipeline mapping before next lead volume arrives.
suggestions.monday_update: Over the 28-day window, 30 Meta leads entered the system but GHL recorded only 24 contacts and 0 opportunities created. Andrew must audit the GHL workflow connecting Meta instant-form submissions to opportunity creation and confirm the Zoho sync. Success check: the next 5 leads that arrive post-relaunch each generate a GHL opportunity within 1 hour. Verify by Sep 17.
